head: codex/5866-distributed-discovery
title: [v0.92][WP-04.04] Bounded authenticated seed discovery
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5866

## Summary

- treat configured seeds only as bounded addresses and expected peer identities, never as enrollment or membership authority
- bind candidate and seed identity plus transport-certificate generations into requests, proposals, proposal IDs, authenticated envelopes, live authority checks, and post-await admission
- use bounded canonical Prost messages for the frozen discovery wire contract and reject malformed or noncanonical protobuf
- persist bounded request and proposal replay state with immediate redb durability so live replay denial survives restart and capacity returns only after trusted expiry
- leave discovery intentionally unregistered until issue #5878 owns distributed module integration

## Validation

- exact distributed_discovery nextest target: 13 passed, 0 failed
- candidate certificate and seed identity/certificate rotation during exchange: rejected
- unknown/noncanonical protobuf fields: rejected
- restart within signed validity: replay rejected; post-expiry capacity recovered
- real mutual-TLS Quinn/rustls discovery round trip: passed
- qualified strict focused Clippy: passed with only the pre-existing ACIP baseline lint allowed
- exact v3 two-revision generation/protobuf/durable proof receipt: passed
- independent exact-head security/correctness review: passed with no findings

## Boundary

This child owns only adl-runtime/src/distributed/discovery.rs and adl-runtime/tests/distributed_discovery.rs plus its typed lifecycle/evidence. Module registration and production replay-store path wiring remain exclusively owned by #5878.
